title: Japan in a Nutshell | Group Tour Package
highlights: Discover Japan's ancient traditions and modern marvels amidst vibrant cityscapes and serene landscapes that offer a scenic escape.
Enjoy the panoramic beauty of Lake Saiko, surrounded by scenic landscapes, lush greenery, that offers a serene getaway in Japan
Experience Lake Kawaguchi’s crystal-clear waters and marvel at the panoramic views of Mt. Fuji, Japan's highest peak.
Dive into the vibrant energy of Akihabara Electric Town, where neon lights and bustling shops create a haven for manga and anime fans.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel
2 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast

exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage to any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. The travelers will be accommodated at a property of a similar standard if they are unavailable.
Meals in restaurants or cafes are not included.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon your arrival at Tokyo International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. After checking in, board the metro (tickets included) to Shinjuku District. Here, you can wander through its bustling streets, visit the serene Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden, explore the vibrant Shinjuku Golden Gai with its tiny restaurants and bars, and discover many more attractions. Later, return to your hotel by metro (tickets included) for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to explore Tokyo. During this day trip, explore the scenic landscape of Zojoji Temple, which offers views of Tokyo Tower. Then, head to Shibuya Crossing, the world's most crowded junction, and visit the Meiji Shrine. Travel along Omotesando Street and wander through Akihabara, the “Electric Town.”. Visit the famous Imperial Palace, Sensoji Temple, the iconic Nijubashi Bridge, and many more attractions. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kawaguchiko | Kawaguchi Lake Boat Ride | Visit Mt. Fuji-5th Station
days.desc: After checkout, board your transfer to explore the Mount Fuji region. Visit Arakurayama Sengen Park for stunning views of Mount Fuji, then explore Kawaguchiko’s natural landscape. Then, visit Fuji Sengen Shrine, the traditional pilgrimage starting point, and enjoy a boat trip on Kawaguchiko Lake. Ascend to Mount Fuji’s fifth station for forest and Mt. Fuji views. Return to Kawaguchiko for a stay at a Ryokan, a traditional Japanese hotel, where you can enjoy the onsen.

items.title: Journey from Tokyo to Kawaguchiko | En Route Sigtseeing Tour

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | En-Route Visit Iyasi No Sato Nenba, Shiraito Falls and Toyota Museum
days.desc: Check out of your hotel in the morning and board your transfer to Kyoto. En route, enjoy the scenic beauty of Lake Kawaguchi and Saiko. After that, explore Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a village restored as an open-air museum with a traditional Japanese water mill, and visit the Watanabe Museum. Continue your journey and visit Shiraito Falls and the Toyota Museum, a must-see for motor enthusiasts. Later, continue to Kyoto, and upon arrival, check into the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Kyoto. En route, enjoy the panoramic views of Arashiyama as we cross the Togetsukyo Bridge. Visit Tenryuji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Next, visit Fushimi Inari Shrine, the Imperial Palace, and Kinkakuji Temple, known as the Golden Pavilion. Then, get transferred to GION, known as the city’s entertainment district and famous for Geisha performers. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Nagano via Tsumago and Matsumoto | Visit to Crow Castle in Matsumoto
days.desc: Today, check out of your hotel in Kyoto and board the transfer to Nagano.  Enjoy the scenic view of the countryside along the way. En route, make a stop at Tsumago. Explore this beautiful village with its traditional wooden houses. Afterward, get transferred to Matsumoto, where we’ll visit the impressive 16th-century “Crow Castle,” and you can explore the vicinity of the vibrant city. Then, continue to Nagano, and upon arrival, check in to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ikaho | Visit Zenkoji Temple and Monkey Park | Leisure Time in Kusatsu
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to visit Zenkoji Temple, a pilgrimage site housing Japan’s first Buddhist image. You can also participate in the Gomakuyo ceremony. Then visit Monkey Park, a natural habitat for conserving Japanese macaques.  Make your next stop at Kusatsu, a lively spa town known for its open-air onsens. Finally, continue your journey to Ikaho, and upon arrival, check in to a Ryokan and enjoy hot spring baths at Onsen.

days.title: Depart to Tokyo via Nikko | Nikko Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, check out of your hotel and board your transfer to Nikko. Experience the impressive Nikko-Toshogu Temple, which enshrines the most famous samurai leader, Tokugawa Ieyasu. Then, visit the famous hall of the Crying Dragon and Taiyuinbyo mausoleum, designed with a blend of Japanese and Chinese architectural styles. Enjoy a stroll by the river in Kanmangafuchi. After that, you can enjoy some leisure time. Later, get transferred to Tokyo.
